data.content_preview:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

These buttery, tender blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch. Made with fresh or frozen blueberries and a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, vanilla, and lemon zest.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.

Nutritional Info

Per scone: ~320 calories, 16g fat, 40g carbs, 4g protein.

Prep Time: 15 minutes

  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • Additional cream for brushing
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the chilled butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Gently fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Carefully fold in blueberries, trying not to crush them.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle about 1-inch thick.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

By Chef Alex | Published: 2025-08-15

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
  6. Gently fold in blueberries.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place on baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Chef's Notes

For a glaze, mix 1 cup powdered sugar with 2 tablespoons milk and drizzle over cooled scones.

data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

HomeRecipesAbout

Blueberry Scones

Published: 2025-09-15

These delicious blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or an afternoon treat. They are buttery, flaky, and loaded with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Let cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with a simple glaze.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
# Blueberry Scones

A delightful, easy-to-follow recipe for fluffy, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries.

## Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh blueberries

## Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with cream.
8. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

## Tips
- For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Coded Culinary

HomeRecipesAbout

Blueberry Scones

Published: 2025-09-15

These delicious blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or an afternoon treat. They are buttery, flaky, and loaded with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Let cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with a simple glaze.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe - CodedCulinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

These tender, buttery scones are bursting with fresh blueberries and perfect for a weekend treat.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, chilled and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream, plus more for brushing
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush tops with cream and bake for 18-22 minutes until golden.

Prep time: 15 min | Cook time: 20 min | Servings: 8

data.content_preview:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

These buttery, tender blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or brunch. Made with fresh or frozen blueberries and a hint of lemon zest.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, cream, vanilla, and lemon zest.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with sugar.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.

Nutritional Info

Per scone: ~320 calories, 16g fat, 40g carbs, 4g protein.
